Subject: Observability add-on: flexible retention + dashboard seats (pricing discussion)

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the demo last week. We ran the traffic profile past our infra and product teams and have a few follow-ups specific to observability add-ons before procurement green-lights the SOW:

- Can you confirm retention pricing by GB-month and whether samples (trace spans) are billed separately? Our mix is ~6 TB/month of logs and ~25M spans/month.
- Advanced dashboards: do you price per seat or per dashboard instance? We have many viewers but only ~12 power users.
- Any pilot voucher or trial credits for assessing retention-level costs?

Attaching our annotated SOW and current usage snapshot for reference (alpha-sow-comments.docx).

Goal: work toward a fixed add-on budget for Q2.

Thanks,
Suzanne Martinez
Head of Platform, AlphaCorp
(suzanne@alphacorp.com)

Attachment: alpha-sow-comments.docx (docx)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-on: flexible retention + dashboard seats (pricing discussion)

Hi Suzanne —

Appreciate the usage snapshot — that helps a lot. High-level answers and three options we recommend based on AlphaCorp's profile: 

1) Short pilot (3 months):
   - Retention: $0.24 / GB-month for raw logs; includes automatic compression at 95th percentile.
   - Tracing ingest: $1.40 / 100k spans (ingest only; storage billed as GB-months after aggregation).
   - Dashboards: seat-based for power users ($35 / seat / month), unlimited viewers via role-based links.
   - Pilot voucher: $15,000 credit toward observability add-ons (applies to retention + tracing)

2) 12-month commit (recommended for predictability):
   - Retention: $0.18 / GB-month (10% discount on listed for usage > 10 TB/mo).
   - Tracing ingest: $1.10 / 100k spans.
   - Seat bundle: 12 seats included, additional seats $28 / seat / month.
   - SLA: 99.9% retention-read availability, monthly billing, 30-day invoice terms (procurement asked for this).

3) Enterprise saver (24-month):
   - Retention: $0.12 / GB-month (deeper volume tiering for >50 TB/mo).
   - Tracing ingest: $0.80 / 100k spans + 20% committed-capacity credit toward burst usage.
   - Seat credits: convert unused seats into dashboard credits applied to next invoice.

A few clarifications/notes:
- EU region pricing is ~8% higher for storage due to regional infra costs — we can provide a regional split if you have a geo breakdown.
- We can also offer monthly sampling windows (e.g., keep full traces for last 30 days, sampled tails for 90 days) to reduce effective GB-months.
- I'll attach our latest pricing matrix; see redwood-observability-pricing-v2.pdf.

Next steps: if you want the procurement-friendly quote, we can lock option (2) at 15% off list for a signed SOW by Apr 5. Otherwise I can prepare a pilot SOW that applies the $15k voucher and a 30-day pilot start.

Looping in Dev for billing mechanics and Marcus for the trace retention compression details.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
Irene.Choi@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-observability-pricing-v2.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Observability add-on: flexible retention + dashboard seats (pricing discussion)

Irene —

Thanks; that helps map things. A couple of procurement constraints to flag:
- Our finance team prefers a single monthly line-item rather than separate per-GB + per-span invoices. Is there a bundled SKU you can create with a clear conversion to our current usage?
- Seat pricing: procurement will push back on per-seat charges unless power-user seats are enforced by SSO/role. We need an option to buy seat credits that can be consumed by named users or reallocated.
- The $15k pilot voucher sounds perfect for starting. Can you confirm voucher applies even if we opt for the 12-month plan within the pilot period?

Also, Rajiv asked whether we can get a representative sample invoice and a DocuSign link — we need that for month-end Legal review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Suzanne

Suzanne —

Thanks for the précis. Quick replies inline and next actions: 

- Bundled SKU: we can produce a single bundled SKU that normalizes your current usage into (A) GB-month retention and (B) 100k-span blocks. We will provide the sample invoice showing both the normalized line item and the decomposition for audit.
- Seat credits: confirmed — we can issue seat credits that are allocatable (named or pooled). Unused seat credits convert to dashboard credits on a monthly basis for the contract length.
- Voucher: the $15k pilot voucher can be applied retroactively to the 12-month commit if you sign the SOW within 30 days of pilot start (we'll add that clause to the SOW).

Offer adjustment for procurement: commit to option (2) (12 months) and we can stretch to a 15% list discount plus the pilot credit. If AlphaCorp can commit to a 24-month term, we can move to 25% discount and a complimentary dashboard migration session.

I've attached:
- redwood-observability-pricing-v2.pdf (pricing matrix)
- sample-invoice-alpha.csv (example billing breakdown) — will send via secure Drive link when you confirm.

Next steps:
1) I'll have Dev produce the custom bundled SKU and the sample invoice (HubSpot deal AC-4591).
2) If you'd like to proceed, I'll push the SOW to DocuSign and mark the pilot voucher clause.

Please let me know if you'd like Marcus to do a short technical call on trace retention tuning before the pilot.

Best,
Irene
